infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sanjivani requires your location to pinpoint your emergency coordinates and dispatch rescue services accurately.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sanjivani requires camera access to attach real-time photo evidence of the disaster scenario to your emergency report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sanjivani requires photo library access to upload disaster evidence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Sanjivani to use your location for emergency dispatch.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sanjivani to access camera for incident reporting.
